submitted_runs.latest_observation: Failed before any NeMo-RL acceptance/throughput metric. The concrete failure was MegatronPolicyWorker creation: FileNotFoundError for nrl_megatron_ckpts_20260526/Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B/iter_0000000/run_config.yaml after workers printed 'Checkpoint already exists ... Skipping import.' This was a checkpoint-completion race: validate_model_paths treated the iter_0000000 directory as a complete checkpoint even though run_config.yaml was missing. The remote SpecDec-RL patch now treats a Megatron checkpoint as existing only when iter_0000000/run_config.yaml exists.

specdec_gate.note: Corrected PublicHF diagnostic. The launcher now explicitly passes policy.model_name=Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507, matching the NVIDIA PublicHF Eagle3 drafter family.

submitted_runs.latest_observation: Submitted after patching the 235B launchers to pass policy.model_name explicitly and patching Megatron checkpoint-complete detection to require iter_0000000/run_config.yaml. The job completed 4/4 steps at 17:50 PDT with ExitCode 0:0. Ray workers were online at 128/128, the driver log confirmed policy.model_name=Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 plus the NVIDIA PublicHF Eagle3 speculative_config, vLLM V1 engine initialization with enforce_eager=false and CUDA Graph mode, target safetensors loading to 118/118, and the observed 1/1 drafter safetensors load. Steps 1-4 emitted completed Generation Worker Group and E2E metrics. Generated throughput is 63.70, 43.39, 73.58, and 61.78 generated tok/s/GPU with acceptance 62.82%, 69.01%, 65.82%, and 65.20%. Mean generated throughput is 60.61 tok/s/GPU, mean acceptance is 65.71%, mean E2E throughput is 43.60 tok/s/GPU, and mean total step time is 475.04s. Scheduler gate metrics show enabled_ratio=1.0 and disabled=0 for all 4 steps, and runner logs show active requests ranging from 1 to 64 with per-worker scheduled tokens up to 128 under token_threshold=4096. This confirms the drafter is active, but also proves this token threshold was too loose to demonstrate lower-batch-only activation. Matched Thinking-2507 baseline job 3088636 now has a Step 1 baseline metric, but strict speedup should still wait for matching multi-step baseline and strict-gate SpecDec metrics.

gate_metrics_observation.interpretation: Runtime gate is configured, but token_threshold=4096 did not disable SpecDec in any observed step. Runner logs show active requests up to 64 and per-worker scheduled tokens up to 128, so this setting is effectively always-on for this workload and is not proof of lower-batch-only activation.
